raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the paternal grandfather by going one generation too far back. After confirming that Jean Bretagne Charles de La Trémoille’s father was Charles Armand René de La Trémoille (the correct paternal grandfather), the Planner instead concluded that Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille—Charles Armand René’s father—was the grandfather, conflating the great-grandfather with the grandfather.
